_comment: The property model's tax rules, as the platform ships them — NEW ZEALAND. Every value here reproduces the source workbook exactly, so a group that changes nothing gets the figures the workbook gives. A group (normally a country) sets its own; a firm may correct them; an advisor types over them on the screen for one client. See design/MULTIPLE-PROPERTY-ASSESSMENT.md §8 Q3/Q5/Q6 and design/features/tier-cascade.md.
